name: myzelium
description: Makes each Claude Code session in a Myzelium project aware of the other work on it: other sessions, VirtualCoder runs and overlapping files, as a brief at session start and the get_sibling_sessions MCP tool.

api_key.title: Myzelium MCP key
api_key.description: The chmcp_… key from Myzelium → Settings → MCP keys (the same one your Myzelium MCP connection uses)

api_url.title: Myzelium API URL
api_url.description: Leave as is unless you run your own Myzelium
